items.title: Ike Robertson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: I know him from Tippet or the little kid. Well, that one died out there by the name of Albert Giles.

ctx.x: Who was his favorite son clarinet? Who did he like to use on clarinet?

Well, he used to get this little fella, George Lewis. He was the only lad, George Lewis. He used to play with him all the time. That's what George told me he played since then. Yeah. And he used to use the solo for what he used to play with bass drum, what he used to play with Ben and Tippet or Clay. Clay. Oh, yeah. Giles. Yeah, I want to say Giles.
